title: RelaxAI – UK sovereign LLM inference at 80% cheaper than OpenAI/Claude
summary: RelaxAI offers UK-sovereign LLM inference services at 80% lower cost compared to OpenAI and Anthropic's Claude, targeting businesses requiring data residency in the UK while reducing AI operational expenses.
problem_solved: High costs associated with using major LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic Claude for businesses requiring UK-based AI inference.
why_valuable: Delivers 80% cost savings while ensuring UK data sovereignty, making enterprise AI more accessible and compliant with regional data regulations.
